claims.disproof_condition: 條件：東台下一份年報的印刷電路板加工機營收占比或金額與此不符，或它改寫 PCB 鑽孔機需求轉弱。核查頻率：每年（年報）＋每季（財報）。觸發後 48 小時：更正這條 claim。
claims.statement: Tongtai Machine & Tool reports that PCB processing machines were NT$527 million or 9.84% of FY2025 revenue (machining centres 51.43%, CNC lathes 17.63%); it has sold more than 10,000 PCB mechanical drilling, routing and laser drilling machines cumulatively, and expects demand for high-end PCB drilling machines to keep growing strongly for 2–3 years on AI compute demand. Low purity for this layer; self-reported.
